scenarios.name: Standard Use Case
scenarios.description: User invokes scrape-leads with typical input and expects correct output

scenarios.name: Empty/Missing Input
scenarios.description: User provides no input or empty data — skill should handle gracefully

scenarios.name: Large Input
scenarios.description: User provides unusually large or complex input — skill should not crash

scenarios.name: Error Recovery
scenarios.description: External service fails (API timeout, auth error) — skill should report clearly

scenarios.name: Output Quality
scenarios.description: Verify the output is actionable, well-formatted, and matches the skill's purpose

scenarios.name: Integration Check
scenarios.description: Skill interacts correctly with any external tools, APIs, or files it references

criteria: Task Completion: Does the skill achieve its stated purpose of "Scrape leads via Apify with iterative filter refinement, verify quality, classif"?
Error Handling: Does the skill handle missing inputs, API failures, and edge cases without crashing?
Output Quality: Is the output well-structured, actionable, and formatted for the user?
Tool Usage: Does the skill correctly reference and use the tools/APIs it depends on?
Instructions Clarity: Are the execution steps clear enough for an agent to follow without ambiguity?
Completeness: Does the skill cover the full scope of its described functionality?
